title: Khl polypeptide, and use thereof in preparation of tabp-eic cell
abstract: Provided in the present disclosure are a KHL polypeptide, and the use thereof in the preparation of a TABP-EIC cell. In addition, also provided in the present disclosure are a KHL polypeptide conjugate, a tumor-antigen-binding polypeptide containing the KHL polypeptide, a DNA molecule, a carrier, a host cell and a pharmaceutical composition. The tumor-antigen-binding polypeptide is composed of the KHL polypeptide, a transmembrane domain and/or a signal transduction domain.

title: D3 binding molecules and uses thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides D3 binding molecules, including anti-D3 antibodies, and uses thereof.

title: Anti-vegf antibody and use thereof
abstract: Provided is an isolated antigen binding protein capable of binding to VEGF protein and/or capable of blocking binding of VEGF protein to VEGFR protein. Further provided is a use of the isolated antigen binding protein in the preparation of a drug.

title: Tnap inhibitory compound and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a tissue-nonspecific alkaline phosphatase (TNAP) inhibitory compound and a use thereof in relation to the prevention or treatment of diseases associated with TNAP over-expression or over-activation. The compound is a compound represented by chemical formula 1 or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

title: Slow-release cytokine conjugates
abstract: This disclosure generally relates to releasable cytokine conjugates and methods of using the same.

title: Material centering device
abstract: The utility model discloses a well device is decided to material, include: the two mounting seats are oppositely arranged at intervals along the width direction of the material; and the centering mechanism comprises two retaining roller assemblies which are respectively arranged on the two mounting bases, and each retaining roller assembly comprises a retaining roller mounting part connected with the mounting base and a plurality of retaining rollers which are rotatably arranged on the retaining roller mounting part, and in the conveying process of the material, the two sides of the material are respectively matched with the plurality of retaining rollers in a rolling manner. The utility model provides a material is put well, can avoid the material to become wrinkled, tensile problem, improves well-defined precision.

title: Extruder screw rod convenient to dismantle
abstract: The utility model discloses an extruder screw convenient to detach, which comprises a box body, wherein one side of the lower end of the inner wall of the box body is connected with a partition plate, the upper end of the partition plate is connected with the upper end of the inner wall of the box body, and the middle part of one side of the partition plate is connected with a screw rod. This extruder screw rod convenient to dismantle, through the mutual cooperation of lead screw, movable block, riding block, connecting cylinder, connecting block, draw-in groove, fixture block and connecting rod that set up, can conveniently drive the connecting cylinder and remove to one side for the fixture block joint is inside the draw-in groove, and the motor drive of being convenient for drives the screw rod body and rotates, makes screw rod body and motor be the separation form, is convenient for dismantle the auger fast, has increased the practicality; through the mutually supporting of connecting cylinder, first mounting panel, second mounting panel, extrusion tube, fixed plate and the connecting block that set up, be convenient for quick with extrusion tube and connecting cylinder separation, and then realize being convenient for take out the screw rod body from inside dismantlement of connecting cylinder and overhaul the processing.

title: Conveying and packaging integrated device for water heating casting external member
abstract: The utility model discloses an integrative device of conveying encapsulation of hot-water heating casting external member, including first transport mechanism and second transport mechanism, still include packagine machine and construct, first transport mechanism with be provided with between the second transport mechanism packagine machine constructs, first transport mechanism sets up second transport mechanism is the top to one side, packagine machine constructs including supporting mechanism, bag sealing mechanism, pushing mechanism, the supporting mechanism below is provided with bag sealing mechanism, bag sealing mechanism below is provided with pushing mechanism. The utility model discloses packagine machine constructs's setting has realized the function to the continuous automatic encapsulation of material with the effect of conveying next process automatically, improved production efficiency and reduced intensity of labour.

title: Automatic material pumping machine
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic material pumping machine which comprises a rack and a bowl body, wherein a butterfly valve is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the rack, a pipe joint is connected to one section of the butterfly valve, the pipe joint is connected with a downstream vacuum conveyor, a hose is connected to one end of the butterfly valve, a guide rail is arranged on the inner wall of one side of the rack, a sliding block is connected to the guide rail in a sliding mode, a moving plate is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the sliding block through a bolt, an air cylinder is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the moving plate through a bolt, a suction nozzle is connected to one end of the air cylinder, the suction nozzle is connected with the hose, a conveying line is arranged on the inner wall of one side of the rack, the bowl body is located on the conveying line, the suction nozzle is located above the bowl body, and an ash hopper is arranged at the bottom of the rack. According to the invention, the pipe joint is arranged, the hose is connected with the butterfly valve and the pipe joint and the downstream vacuum conveyor, so that materials can be conveyed into the downstream vacuum conveyor through the suction nozzle and the pipeline system, the butterfly valve is closed when the materials are not conveyed, and the materials in the pipeline are prevented from returning to the suction nozzle, thereby causing equipment pollution.

title: Large shell turnover mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a large shell turnover mechanism which comprises a driving platform, wherein the driving platform is provided with a driving assembly, the driving assembly is provided with a long shaft, two ends of the long shaft are provided with guide flat keys which are axially distributed, the two guide flat keys are respectively provided with a transmission assembly in a sliding manner, a clamping assembly is connected to the transmission assembly which is far away from one side of the guide flat keys in a pivot manner, a transmission carrier plate of the transmission assembly is provided with an adjusting cylinder, the piston end of the adjusting cylinder is fixed on the driving platform through a connecting piece, the telescopic movement of the adjusting cylinder can drive the transmission assembly to move back and forth on the guide flat keys, the clamping assembly is provided with a fixed clamping end and a movable clamping end, and the movable clamping end moves up and down under the driving of the clamping cylinder. The clamping assembly is driven to turn over through the transmission assembly, meanwhile, the clamping assembly can clamp the product by driving the clamping cylinder, the structure is compact, and the requirements of production layout are met.

title: Light detection device
abstract: A light detection device includes a substrate including a light detection element, a chip disposed on the substrate, an embedded layer disposed to cover the chip, a seam portion that appears within the embedded layer and extends to a front surface of the embedded layer, and a sealing layer disposed to cover the embedded layer and the seam portion.

title: Method for producing electronic device, and cover glass
abstract: To suppress the generation of an outgas in order to suppress deterioration of the optical characteristics of a cover glass. This method for producing an electronic device comprises: a baking step for heating a cover glass on which an antireflective layer that is formed of a cured product of an uncured photocurable resin containing a photopolymerization component is formed; an assembly step for installing the cover glass after the baking step in a position facing a light-receiving surface of a sensor element and assembling a sensor module; and a reflow step for placing the sensor module on a mounting substrate and heating the sensor module at a temperature higher than or equal to 250 DEG C so as to solder the sensor module onto the mounting substrate. The baking step is performed before the reflow step so that, in the reflow step, the generation ratio of an outgas derived from the photopolymerization component among the outgasses generated from the antireflective layer of the cover glass is less than or equal to 0.3% by mass with respect to the mass of the antireflective layer.

title: Top gate type thin film transistor substrate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A top gate type thin film transistor substrate comprises a substrate, a light shielding layer, a metal oxide layer arranged on the light shielding layer, a buffer layer, a semiconductor film layer arranged on the buffer layer and a dielectric layer arranged on the buffer layer. The dielectric layer is provided with two through holes communicated with the semiconductor film layer through patterning. The contact hole is arranged on the metal oxide layer and penetrates through the dielectric layer and the buffer layer. The bottom of the contact hole is close to the metal oxide layer, and a metal contact block is formed through a conductor process. The source electrode and the drain electrode are respectively arranged on the two through holes, wherein the source electrode extends into the contact hole and is connected with the metal contact block.

title: Semiconductor device and composition for forming back surface protective film
abstract: This semiconductor device comprises a semiconductor substrate, a back surface protective film that protects the back surface of the semiconductor substrate, and a forgery prevention layer that is provided on the back surface protective film and contains a pattern-forming substance that forms an authenticity-determining pattern, wherein the back surface protective film contains an inorganic pigment.

title: Composite substrate and method for manufacturing composite substrate
abstract: The invention provides a composite substrate with suppressed warpage. The composite substrate according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: the piezoelectric film is composed of a polycrystal having a c-axis orientation degree of 80% or less, which is determined by the Lotgering method.

title: Efficient preparation method of nano silicon dioxide based on biomass power plant ash
abstract: The invention discloses a high-efficiency preparation method of nano silicon dioxide based on biomass power plant ash. The method comprises the steps of firstly crushing, sieving and drying ash of a biomass power plant, then adding HCl solution with concentration not exceeding 5mol/L according to the solid-to-liquid ratio of 1:8-1:10, heating and refluxing at a constant temperature, performing suction filtration and drying to obtain acid pretreatment ash, mixing the acid pretreatment ash with NaOH solid according to the mass ratio of 1:0.6-1:1.4, activating at a high temperature to obtain alkali fusion ash, adding NaOH solution with concentration not exceeding 5mol/L into the alkali fusion ash according to the solid-to-liquid ratio of 1:8-1:10, heating and refluxing at a constant temperature, performing suction filtration to obtain water glass solution, finally, introducing CO 2 into the water glass solution in a constant-temperature water bath kettle for a period of time, aging for 0-72 hours under normal temperature, performing suction filtration and drying to obtain nano silicon dioxide. The invention takes the waste biomass ash as the raw material, has low cost and simple process, and the prepared nano silicon dioxide has high purity and high extraction rate, thereby realizing the utilization of waste resources and reducing the preparation cost of the nano silicon dioxide.

title: Raw material pretreatment device for preparing nano titanium oxide
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of raw material pretreatment, and discloses a raw material pretreatment device for preparing nano titanium oxide, which comprises a base, wherein a water storage cylinder is fixedly connected to the right side of the top of the base, a sliding groove is formed in the front side of the water storage cylinder, a pulling ring is connected to the inside of the sliding groove in a sliding manner, a filter plate is arranged in the pulling ring, an active carbon plate I is fixedly connected to the inside of the water storage cylinder, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the front side of the base, two sliding rods are connected to the top of the mounting plate in a sliding manner, springs are sleeved outside the two sliding rods, a limiting block is fixedly connected to the top of the two sliding rods, a supporting component is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the base, a stirring cylinder is fixedly connected to the inside of the supporting component, and a limiting component is fixedly connected to the bottom of the stirring cylinder. According to the utility model, the filter plate can be quickly replaced by pulling the ring to match with the limiting block, so that the service life of the device is prolonged.

title: PET composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a PET composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein the PET composition comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of PET, 5-12 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 1-5 parts of epoxy resin, 0.3-10mol% of IPA monomer in the PET, and 79-96.5 mol% of alcoholysis degree of the polyvinyl alcohol. According to the invention, PET with specific IPA monomer content and polyvinyl alcohol with specific alcoholysis degree are selected, so that the adhesive strength and hydrolysis resistance can be remarkably improved.

title: Preparation method of carbonization amorphous silicon dioxide with controllable structure and morphology
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of carbonization amorphous silicon dioxide with controllable structure and morphology. Firstly, carbon dioxide, naHCO 3 solution and low-concentration water glass react at normal pressure to generate silicon dioxide cores, controlling the cationic chemical environment in the growth environment, controlling the gas-liquid flow field in a kettle through a self-suction gas redistributor under high pressure, controlling the temperature to 80-150 ℃, continuing carbonization until the pH value of a reaction system is reduced to be below 9.0, and under the condition, performing core-induced growth to form amorphous silicon dioxide with a specific structure, and performing solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain amorphous silicon dioxide functional powder with adjustable specific surface area and pore volume. The invention can adjust the morphology and pore canal structure of the amorphous silica under the condition of no additive, avoid the problem of sodium sulfate wastewater discharge caused by the introduction of the structure regulating additive in the production process of the amorphous silica by the traditional sulfuric acid method, and improve the particle size distribution and the morphology of the powder of the silica.

title: Method for extracting fullerene from waste coke of acetylene black conductive agent
abstract: The invention relates to a method for extracting fullerene from waste coke of acetylene black conductive agent. A method for extracting fullerene from waste acetylene black conductive agent coke comprises the following steps of carrying out heat treatment on waste acetylene black conductive agent coke to obtain pretreated waste acetylene black conductive agent coke, carrying out ultrasonic extraction treatment on the pretreated waste acetylene black conductive agent coke by taking imidazole ionic liquid as an extracting agent under an ultrasonic condition, separating to obtain ionic liquid extract rich in fullerene and solid residues, and carrying out step cooling crystallization treatment on the ionic liquid extract rich in fullerene to obtain C 70 fullerene and C 60 fullerene. The invention realizes the recycling and recycling of the waste coke of the acetylene black conductive agent, solves the problems of potential safety hazard and environmental pollution existing in the existing fullerene extraction method, and solves the problems of complicated separation and purification steps, high energy consumption and long production period existing in the existing fullerene extraction method.

title: Acquisition circuit with selectable switching value judgment threshold
abstract: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit with an optional switching value judgment threshold, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first interface, a second interface, a first resistor, a second interface, a second resistor, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, an operational amplifier, a voltage dividing circuit and an optocoupler; the first interface is used for accessing an external sensor; the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the first interface, and the inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with an external switching value input interface; one end of the first resistor is connected between the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier and the first interface, and the other end of the second resistor is connected with the second interface and then grounded; the second interface is connected with external 24V voltage through a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor respectively; the voltage dividing circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier and the optical coupler; the optocoupler is connected to an external central chip. The utility model can easily adjust and adapt to the threshold value of switch detection, thereby better meeting different functional and performance requirements.

title: Solar infrared remote control CT polarity detection device
abstract: The invention relates to a solar infrared remote control CT polarity detection device, which comprises a power circuit, a voltage stabilizing circuit, an infrared remote control circuit and an output circuit, wherein the power circuit comprises a solar panel and a storage battery pack, a positive lead-out wire of the storage battery pack is respectively connected with the voltage stabilizing circuit and the output circuit, the infrared remote control circuit comprises an infrared receiving special chip CX20106, a 7 pin of the chip CX20106 is respectively connected with a resistor R2 and an input end of a NOR gate U1A, the other end of the resistor R2 is respectively connected with an output end and VCC of a sliding rheostat, the other input end of the NOR gate U1A is connected with a low-power relay JR, the output end of the NOR gate U1A is connected with an input end of a diode D2, the output end of the diode D2 is respectively connected with a resistor R3, a capacitor C4 and an input end of a NAND gate U2A, the other end of the resistor R3 is respectively connected with a resistor R4 and a grounding end, and the other end of the resistor R4 is connected with the other end of the capacitor C4; the invention has the advantages of detecting the secondary circuit, checking the cable core and correcting the CT polarity.

title: Cable length detection device and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a cable length detection device and a detection method thereof, and the cable length detection device comprises a working base table and a fixed winding frame, wherein the fixed winding frame is arranged behind one side of the upper end of the working base table; the sliding bottom frame is arranged at the front end of one side of the upper end of the working bottom table, a mounting seat is fixedly mounted above the sliding bottom frame, a measuring frame is fixedly mounted above the mounting seat, and a control box is fixedly mounted above the working bottom table along one side of the sliding bottom frame. The cable disassembling device has the advantages that the cable disassembling capability is convenient, and the problem that the operation is very troublesome when the cable is maintained or replaced for disassembling is solved.

title: Intelligent electrical equipment, single chip microcomputer adaptive to microwave detector and microwave detector
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent electric device, a single chip microcomputer adapted to a microwave detector, a microwave detector and a microwave transmitting method thereof, wherein the microwave detector is adapted to a single chip microcomputer, wherein the single chip microcomputer comprises a frequency source, a single chip microcomputer main body communicably connected to the frequency source and a frequency output port, wherein the microwave detector comprises a frequency synthesizer and a transmitting circuit, wherein the frequency synthesizer can synthesize and control a transmitting frequency signal according to a basic frequency provided by the frequency source of the single chip microcomputer after communicably connected to the frequency output port, wherein the transmitting circuit is communicably connected to the frequency synthesizer, wherein the transmitting circuit transmits a detecting microwave according to the transmitting frequency signal synthesized and controlled by the frequency synthesizer, the microwave detector does not use a crystal oscillator, and is beneficial to miniaturization and integration of the microwave detector.

title: Optical isolation type rotary-changing processing circuit
abstract: The invention discloses an optical isolation type rotary transformer processing circuit which comprises an MCU, an optical isolation module, a rotary transformer resolving module, a following amplifying module, a push-pull filtering module, a rotary transformer and a power module, wherein the MCU controls the signal output of the rotary transformer resolving module through the optical isolation module, the output of the rotary transformer resolving module is electrically connected with the following amplifying module, the following amplifying module is electrically connected with the push-pull filtering module, the push-pull filtering module is electrically connected with the rotary transformer, the feedback signal of the rotary transformer is electrically connected with the rotary transformer resolving module, resolving data are transmitted to the MCU through the optical isolation module, and the MCU, the optical isolation module, the rotary transformer resolving module, the following amplifying module and the push-pull filtering module are all electrically connected with the power module.

title: Communication method and related equipment
abstract: A communication method comprises the steps of receiving a first request of a first network element, wherein the first request is used for indicating data registration, the first request carries information of data which can be provided by the first network element, the first network element is a producer of the data, receiving a second request of a second network element, the second request comprises data requirements, and sending first information to the second network element, the first information is used for acquiring the data, and the data corresponding to the information of the data meets the data requirements. Based on the technical scheme, the data registration process as the data producer is defined, the data registration process is simplified, the data registration and data collection efficiency is improved, and the data registration process as the data producer does not need to be triggered when the data consumer requests to subscribe to data or analyze, so that the integrity and the reliability of the data can be ensured.

title: Data processing method, terminal device and storage medium
abstract: A method for data processing includes the following. A terminal device determines a data duplication behavior of a first entity according to first information, where the data duplication behavior is indicative of that the first entity transmits data to at least one second entity in at least three second entities corresponding to the first entity. A terminal device and a storage medium are further provided.

title: Communication method and apparatus
abstract: Provided in the present application are a communication method and apparatus. The communication method comprises: acquiring first information, wherein the first information may be used for indicating an association relationship between a data identifier and a data processing mode, the data processing mode may comprise executing one or more first functions for data processing, and/or skipping one or more second functions for data processing, and the data identifier may comprise a first data identifier; and receiving first data carrying the first data identifier, and processing the first data on the basis of the first data identifier and the association relationship; or, sending the first data carrying the first data identifier. In the present application, different first data identifiers may have association relationships with different data processing modes. Thus, a corresponding functional entity processes first data on the basis of the data processing modes corresponding to the first data identifiers. In this way, appropriate functions are selected in a targeted manner for processing different data, thereby improving the service processing efficiency and the system performance.

title: Service transmission method and device, computer readable storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention provides a service transmission method and device, a computer readable storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the service transmission method comprises the following steps: respectively introducing multiple groups of service data contained in service flow into a first processing path corresponding to each group of service data according to first identification information for processing so as to respectively obtain packet data obtained after processing each group of service data; and sending the plurality of packet data to a receiving side so that the receiving side can acquire the service flow according to the packet data. The invention can solve the problem that networking equipment is too complex due to the influence of a service transmission mode in the networking process in the related technology, thereby achieving the effect of reducing the networking complexity.

title: Information processing device, program, system, and information processing method
abstract: To provide an information processing device, a program, a system, and an information processing method that can acquire in-zone history information indicating the history of a wireless communication device having a communication area in which wireless communication terminals have been in the past.SOLUTION: In a system, an information processing device 100 includes: an information acquisition unit that acquires in-zone history information indicating the history of a wireless communication device having a communication area in which a wireless communication terminal has been in the past; a distribution information determination unit that identifies a predicted course of a user of the wireless communication terminal based on the in-zone history information and determines distribution information to be distributed to the wireless communication terminal based on the predicted course; and a distribution control unit that performs control so as to distribute the distribution information to the wireless communication terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Method for detecting bacterial endotoxin in egg yolk lecithin by gel method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for detecting bacterial endotoxin in egg yolk lecithin by a gel method, which comprises the following steps: determining a limit L of bacterial endotoxin in egg yolk lecithin and a minimum effective dilution concentration c; rechecking the sensitivity of the limulus reagent; carrying out interference pre-test on the test sample solution with different dilution times to find out the maximum non-interference concentration under the condition of no interference, and carrying out interference test on the test sample solution with the maximum non-interference concentration; an absolute ethanol interference test; egg yolk lecithin interference test. According to the method for detecting the bacterial endotoxin in the egg yolk lecithin by the gel method, the bacterial endotoxin in the egg yolk lecithin is accurately detected by a simple method, and the detection of a test solution can effectively eliminate interference.

title: Selenium polysaccharide for improving alcoholic liver injury and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses selenium polysaccharide for improving alcoholic liver injury and a preparation method and application thereof. The selenium-enriched agaricus blazei murill fruiting body is obtained through a selenium-enriched cultivation mode, crude selenium polysaccharide is obtained by extracting the fruiting body by adopting a water extraction and alcohol precipitation method, components larger than 10KD in the agaricus blazei murill polysaccharide are separated by utilizing a hollow fiber tangential flow membrane, and the components are further purified by DEAE-52 and Sephadex G-100 column chromatography to obtain a single selenium polysaccharide component AbPSe, wherein the selenium polysaccharide component consists of glucose, rhamnose, arabinose, mannose and galactose, has good alleviation effect on liver injury caused by long-term drinking, and can be developed into medicines or health care products for preventing and treating alcoholic liver injury.

title: Sperm screening injection dish
abstract: The utility model relates to a sperm screening injection dish, including box body and lid, be provided with a plurality of ovum storage tank, a plurality of sperm washing tank and a plurality of sperm screening groove on the bottom plate of box body, the sperm screening groove includes the screening platform, is located the sperm storage tank on the relative both ends of this screening platform and with the ramp of sperm storage tank and screening platform intercommunication, the top surface of screening platform is no longer than the top surface of bottom plate, and is higher than the sperm storage tank, and this screening platform is rectangular shape, and two sperm storage tanks are located this screening platform length direction's both ends respectively to solve the problem that the injection dish can't separate sperm and impurity completely and influence its injection.

title: Extraction method of astragalus polysaccharide
abstract: The invention discloses an extraction method of astragalus polysaccharide, which comprises the steps of adding purified water into astragalus powder to fully moisten the astragalus powder, then adopting a tunnel microwave dryer to carry out microwave irradiation treatment on the moistened astragalus powder, extracting the astragalus powder subjected to microwave irradiation by using water, controlling the extraction temperature at 35-75 ℃, filtering the extracting solution after the extraction is finished, and carrying out low-temperature concentration and ethanol precipitation to obtain the astragalus polysaccharide. The invention adopts the microwave-water extraction combined technology, and the water molecules in the astragalus cells are heated by microwaves, so that the temperature in the cells is quickly increased, the cells are gasified instantly, the cell walls of cellulose are burst, the content (astragalus polysaccharide) is easy to release, the water extraction method is carried out at a lower temperature, the Maillard reaction is effectively prevented, and the biological activity of the astragalus polysaccharide is better maintained.

title: Medicament adding device with detection function
abstract: The utility model relates to a medicament adding device with a detection function, which comprises a machine body, wherein the left end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a monitoring box, the middle part of the machine body is fixedly connected with a power supply box, the right end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a medicament spraying box, the upper end of the medicament spraying box is provided with an electric rotating shaft seat, the upper end of the electric rotating shaft seat is fixedly connected with a pump machine, the output end of the pump machine is fixedly connected with a stretchable hose, the right end of the stretchable hose is fixedly connected with a spray head, and the upper end of the power supply box is fixedly connected with a solar panel.

title: Power transmission device
abstract: A power transmission device, includes a motor; a gear mechanism connected downstream of the motor; a pump that sucks oil through a pump inlet; and a box that includes a first chamber accommodating the gear mechanism and a second chamber provided with the pump inlet.

title: Motor unit
abstract: To provide a motor unit, one mode of the motor unit of the present invention has: a motor having a rotor that rotates about a motor axis extending in a horizontal direction and a stator located radially outside the rotor; a housing that houses the motor; and oil contained in the housing. The housing is provided with an oil passage for circulating oil and supplying the oil to the motor from an upper side of the motor. A gutter-shaped reservoir which is located above the motor and stores oil is provided in the oil passage. The reservoir has a bottom extending along a horizontal plane. The bottom is provided with: a recess recessed toward a lower side at an upper surface; and a discharge hole which penetrates the bottom part, is opened on the upper surface of the concave part, and supplies the oil in the reservoir to the motor.

title: Driving apparatus for vehicle
abstract: The present invention relates to a driving device for a vehicle and relates to a driving device for a vehicle that generates a driving force in a non-contact manner. The driving device for a vehicle according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an interface unit; a driving unit for transmitting a driving force to the interface unit; a switching unit having a plurality of switches to control power supplied to the driving unit; a relay unit selectively short-circuiting the inside of the driving unit; and a control device controlling the operation of the relay unit. The driving unit comprises: a stator generating a magnetic flux; a first rotor having an inner permanent magnet and rotating by the magnetic flux; an outer permanent magnet provided in a different number from the inner permanent magnets; and a second rotor rotating along a magnetic path between the inner permanent magnet and the outer permanent magnet. The control device rotates the first rotor according to whether the interface unit needs to change its attitude or prevents the rotation of the first rotor by operating the relay unit to short-circuit the inside of the driving unit. Accordingly, it is possible to prevent the rotation of the rotor without adding a separate mechanical structure.

title: Air control device
abstract: To provide an air control device which enables air to freely flow in a bidirectional manner between a first air guide passage and a second air guide passage and is also capable of surely preventing air from flowing between the first air guide passage and the second air guide passage.SOLUTION: When a forward/backward drive mechanism 57 moves a shaft member 51 forward to a first position in an X direction, a first valve body 35 is pressed by the shaft member 51 and moved to one side in the X direction such that air flows from a suction passage 33 into an air filling chamber 45 and a second valve body 36 is moved to the other side in a Y direction, such that a first air guide passage 37 and a second air guide passage 38 are internally communicated. When the backward drive mechanism 57 moves the shaft member 51 backward to a second position in the X direction, the first valve body 35 is moved to the other side in the X direction by an air pressure and seated on a valve seat 41a, such that the air filling chamber 45 is communicated with an exhaustion passage 34, the second valve body 36 is moved to one side in the Y direction by the air pressure, and the first air guide passage 37 and the second air guide passage 38 are internally cut off.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Two-stage fan control method, device, medium and equipment
abstract: The disclosure relates to a two-stage fan control method, apparatus, medium, and device. The method comprises the following steps: after detecting that a power assembly of the vehicle is flamed out, controlling the two-stage fan to operate at a low speed for a preset first time period; acquiring the voltage of a storage battery and the temperature of a first temperature zone, wherein the first temperature zone is an area where one or more of a gear shifting inhaul cable, a chassis heat dissipation water pipe, a chassis wire harness, a chassis fuel oil pipeline and a chassis brake oil pipe of the vehicle are located; and if the voltage of the storage battery is greater than the preset voltage and the temperature of the first temperature zone is greater than a first temperature threshold value, controlling the two-stage fan to run at a high speed. Therefore, heat exchange can be enhanced through wind power generated by high-speed operation of the two-stage fans, heat dissipation is accelerated, the risk of fire hazard is reduced, and safety of vehicles is effectively improved.

title: Laser weeding machine
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of agriculture, in particular to a laser weeding machine which comprises a power supply, a mechanical mounting structure, a system main control module, a functional module, a motor and a driving module thereof. According to the utility model, the two right-angle prism faces are utilized to respectively reflect the light emitted by the opposite spectrometer light source and the light emitted by the laser, the stepping motor can accurately adjust the angle of the right-angle prism, so that two beams of light from the spectrometer light source and the laser can be focused in almost the same micro area, the light beam positioning precision is improved, the reliability and the efficiency of the system are improved, and meanwhile, the complex and expensive dichroic mirror which is necessary to be used in the traditional laser weeding equipment is avoided, thereby greatly simplifying the structure of an optical system, and reducing the production cost and the technical implementation difficulty.

title: Double-lens transmitting and receiving common-lens 3D system
abstract: A dual-lens transmit and receive common-lens 3D system, comprising: a housing; the laser is used for infrared laser; the collimating mirror is positioned on the light path of the infrared laser so as to collimate the infrared laser; the polarization switcher is positioned on the optical path of the infrared laser and is used for changing the polarization state of the infrared laser; the polarization splitting prism is positioned on the light path behind the collimating lens and comprises a first surface, a second surface, a third surface and a fourth surface; the sensor is positioned outside the third surface and is used for receiving the reflected light ray signals; a prism positioned outside the second surface; a 1/4 wave plate positioned outside the fourth surface; a first lens located outside the fourth surface; and the second lens is positioned on the side surface of the prism, which is different from the polarization splitting prism. The FOI of the transmitting end and the FOV of the receiving end can be accurately matched, and the FOI has better performance.

title: Knowledge and data collaborative driven sewage treatment process abnormality monitoring method
abstract: The invention provides a knowledge and data collaborative driving sewage treatment process anomaly monitoring method, which relates to the field of sewage treatment process monitoring and specifically comprises the following steps of designing knowledge features and data feature alignment and excavation by using a self-encoder based on the knowledge and operation data of the sewage treatment process mechanism of an activated sludge process, and realizing feature fusion by using a cross attention mechanism; the method comprises the steps of constructing an anomaly monitoring model based on a Gaussian mixture model, designing a feature-model parameter synchronous updating strategy based on an estimated network, designing an anomaly monitoring evaluation index based on an energy function of negative log likelihood probability, and combining a threshold judgment logic to realize accurate monitoring of the anomaly index. The technical scheme of the invention solves the problem that the monitoring method of the sewage treatment process in the prior art is difficult to consider the accuracy and the interpretability of anomaly monitoring.

title: Correction strategy effectiveness evaluation system based on BP neural network model
abstract: The invention discloses a correction strategy effectiveness evaluation system based on a BP neural network model, which comprises a correction strategy storage module, a task presentation module, a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a result feedback module and a cloud data module, wherein model training is carried out by utilizing the BP neural network by collecting self-made force data of community criminals before and after receiving a judicial correction strategy, the purpose of predicting self-made force results of the community criminals after receiving the correction is achieved, and the effectiveness of the correction strategy is judged by comparing the self-made forces of the community criminals before and after receiving the judicial correction, so that the correction strategy of the current community criminals is adjusted in real time according to the effectiveness results of different correction strategies in each region. The correction strategy provided by judicial is evaluated to effectively reduce the crime risk of the community criminal personnel, a reference basis is provided for the judicial staff to correct the community criminal personnel, and the risk of the community criminal personnel for crime is effectively reduced.

title: Application of protein marker in preparation of rheumatoid arthritis diagnostic kit
abstract: The invention relates to application of a protein marker in preparation of a rheumatoid arthritis diagnosis kit, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The protein marker for diagnosing the rheumatoid arthritis is screened from the plasma and the plasma exosomes, specifically, the AUC of the C4BPA of the source plasma exosomes is 0.878, the specificity is as high as 94.1 percent, and the protein marker has remarkable advantages in the aspect of excluding non-RA people. Both plasma-derived C4BPA and diamine oxidase (DAO) have good diagnostic value in independent diagnosis of RA, AUC being 0.844 and 0.946, respectively. The AUC of the combined diagnostic model constructed based on plasma C4BPA and plasma DAO was raised to 0.965. Therefore, the protein marker has an accurate diagnosis effect on rheumatoid arthritis and has good transformation application prospect on auxiliary diagnosis and risk assessment of RA.
